messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Here’s a quick reference to the Canadian public‑holiday dates that create long weekends in 2023 (national holidays plus the most widely observed provincial ones).  
(If you’re targeting a specific province, let me know and I can narrow it down.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Observed Mon Feb 2 | Jan 1–3 |
| **Family Day (Ontario)** | Feb 20 (Monday) | — | Feb 18–20 |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Friday) | — | Apr 7–9 |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Monday) | — | May 20–22 |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Observed Mon Jul 3 | Jul 1–3 |
| **Civic Holiday (many provinces)** | Aug 7 (Monday) | — | Aug 5–7 |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Monday) | — | Sep 2–4 |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Monday) | — | Oct 7–9 |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 (Saturday) | Observed Mon Nov 13 | Nov 11–13 |
| **Christmas** | Dec 25 (Monday) | — | Dec 23–25 |

> **Note:**  
> • Boxing Day (Dec 26) falls on a Tuesday in 2023, so it does **not** create a long weekend.  
> • Some provinces observe additional holidays (e.g., Family Day on different dates, Civic Holiday only in certain provinces). If you need a province‑specific list, just tell me which one!
